entries.name: Poké Ball
entries.description: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It is thrown like a ball at the target. It is designed as a capsule system.

entries.name: Potion
entries.description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

entries.name: Antidote
entries.description: A spray-type medicine. It lifts the effect of poison from one Pokémon.

entries.name: Paralyze Heal
entries.description: A spray-type medicine. It eliminates paralysis from a single Pokémon.

entries.name: Awakening
entries.description: A spray-type medicine. It awakens a Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.

entries.name: Repel
entries.description: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 100 steps after its use.

entries.name: Super Repel
entries.description: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 200 steps after its use.

entries.name: Escape Rope
entries.description: A long, durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from a cave or a dungeon.

entries.name: DNA Splicers
entries.description: A splicer that fuses the DNA of any two Pokemon into a single entirely new Pokemon.

entries.name: DNA Reverser
entries.description: A splicer that reverses the DNA of a fused Pokémon to create the inverse fusion.

entries.name: Super Potion
entries.description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

entries.name: Great Ball
entries.description: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.

entries.name: Full Heal
entries.description: A spray-type medicine. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

entries.name: Revive
entries.description: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It restores half the Pokémon's maximum HP.

entries.name: Hyper Potion
entries.description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

entries.name: Ultra Ball
entries.description: An ultra-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.

entries.name: Net Ball
entries.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.

entries.name: Dive Ball
entries.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon that live underwater.

entries.name: Nest Ball
entries.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on weaker Pokémon in the wild.

entries.name: Repeat Ball
entries.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon species that were previously caught.

entries.name: Timer Ball
entries.description: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

entries.name: Max Potion
entries.description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It completely restores the HP of a single Pokémon.

entries.name: Full Restore
entries.description: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of a single Pokémon.

entries.name: Quick Ball
entries.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that provides a better catch rate if used at the start of a wild encounter.

entries.name: Dusk Ball
entries.description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places like caves.

entries.name: Luxury Ball
entries.description: A comfortable Poké Ball that makes a caught wild Pokémon quickly grow friendly.

entries.name: Fire Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is colored orange.

entries.name: Thunder Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a thunderbolt pattern.

entries.name: Water Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear, light blue.

entries.name: Leaf Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern.

entries.name: Moon Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as the night sky.

entries.name: Sun Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as red as the sun.

entries.name: Dusk Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as dark as dark can be.

entries.name: Dawn Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It sparkles like eyes.

entries.name: Shiny Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It shines with a dazzling light.

entries.name: Ice Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is made out of ice.

entries.name: Magnet Stone
entries.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has magnetic properties.

entries.name: Everstone
entries.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The Pokémon holding this peculiar stone is prevented from evolving.
